stories.title: Residents can question HyNet pipeline team at Hawarden event this Wednesda
stories.summary: Residents in Flintshire can meet the team behind the HyNet carbon dioxide pipeline at a drop-in event in Hawarden this Wednesday. Liverpool Bay CCS Limited, the company building the pipeline, is holding a community information event at Hawarden Masonic Hall on Wednesday, 21 October, between 4pm and 7pm. stories.title: A494 at Deeside records busiest year in DfT figures with nearly 65,000 vehicles a day
stories.summary: The A494 at Deeside carried an average of 64,710 vehicles a day in 2025, the highest figure for that stretch in Department for Transport (DfT) records going back to 2000. stories.title: 92 per cent of people in Wales want healthier food as the default in schools
stories.summary: Most people in Wales want healthier food and drink to be the default option in schools, hospitals and other public places, according to a Public Health Wales survey. stories.title: More than half of over-50s in Wales struggling with cost of living, Age Cymru survey finds
stories.summary: More than half of over-50s who took part in Age Cymru’s annual survey say they are struggling with the cost of living, up from 9 per cent in 2020. stories.title: Buckley gets one of ten new Network Rail weather stations on railway radio masts
stories.summary: Buckley is one of ten places across Wales and the Borders where Network Rail has fitted weather stations to railway radio masts to help it respond to storms.
